summaries.summary: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were summoned by Delhi Police after their release from jail relating to a probe into a protest.
Tesla announced it will start selling its autonomous Cybercabs by the end of the year, amid federal safety investigations.
An attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd airport resulted in two fatalities, including an Indian national, as regional tensions continue.
YouTube confirmed it is not testing the hiding of the dislike button, despite user speculation and backlash regarding dislike features.
Blackstone’s Jas Khaira addressed concerns over AI-related debt, stating such fears are overstated.
Meta is planning to use a newly created class of stock to finance its extensive investments in AI technologies.
Fitbit launched the new Fitbit Edge tracker, comparing it to the Inspire 3 and showcasing its features in the health tech market.
Airbnb faced backlash after announcing limitations on chores hosts can require from guests, which may drive some hosts off the platform.
Priyanka Gandhi’s son expressed frustration over the removal of his protest photographs from a Delhi exhibition, with officials citing policy violations.
BioWare, after 30 years of influential gaming, has been shut down by EA, resulting in significant layoffs and the cancellation of future projects.
Marco Rubio and Indian businessman Ambani discussed energy, digital infrastructure, and manufacturing at a meeting in Jamnagar refinery.
Apple's new iPhone Duo features notable changes, including improvements to its folding mechanism, which has undergone extensive testing.
